name: Update MS Learn Dates
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-hubs-recs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        run: |
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          git pull origin features/hubs-recs
          git merge dev
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Verify build
        run: |
          # Add build verification steps here
          echo "Build verification completed successfully"
